title: Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company files a Standard Offer Contract for Interruptible City-Gate Supply with FiberMark, Inc., a Vermont corporation with a business located in Fitchburg, Massachusetts.
petitioner: Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company d/b/a Unitil
filings: The Commission hereby APPROVES the Standard Interruptible City-Gate Supply Aggreement. Commissioners participating in the decision were: Janet Gail Besser, Acting Chair; and John D. Patrone, Commissioner.
